svg.text: Southern Company — OT Analytics Multi-Cloud Architecture
Azure for OT Analytics, AWS for Selected Workloads — Energy
Azure DevOps — every infrastructure and data-pipeline change reviewed
and auditable before merge, not pushed directly.
Applies Sentinel/Defender for Cloud/Azure Policy aligned with AWS controls.
(same unification pattern as Truist Bank, earlier in this platform's maturity)
Data-pipeline/connectivity outages: isolate which side of the cross-cloud
link failed first (AWS route tables/SGs vs. Azure NSGs/peering) before
assuming a symmetric failure — see Project-Deep-Dive-and-Interview-Prep.md.
Deliberate best-tool-per-workload split, not a full migration in either
direction — proven with a proof-of-concept comparing both clouds against
the actual OT data patterns before deciding (see Behavioral.md case study).
